run_inference_on_dataset: run inference on a dataset using a model and data loader with optional evaluator checkpointing
patch_DatasetEvaluators_has_finished_pro: patch detectron2 DatasetEvaluators to add a has_finished_process method for skipping redundant processing
create_ResultCache: create a ResultCache utility to save and load evaluation cache data across distributed processes
load_ResultCache: load cached evaluation results from a pickle file with optional gathering across ranks
save_ResultCache: save evaluation data to a per-rank pickle cache file in the specified cache directory
